newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria to issue 3 bln ats preference share. [CORRECTED 10:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria to issue 3 bln ats preference share. [CORRECTED 10:10 GMT]

text.p: Bank Austria said on Monday it would issue preferred shares of three billion schillings based on the share price (corrects from "three billion schilling nominal") under the lead management of Salomon brothers, to be offered to Austrian and international investors.
"In this Bank Austria sees an important step toward the increased participation of private investors in the group," a statement said ahead of a news conference.
